title: Create configured lobbies with private passcodes and unique room codes
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md, docs/design/SWARM-BRIEF-v0.md, docs/design/RULES-SPEC-v1.md and the listed sourceRefs before editing. The imported Rules Spec v1 is the canonical engine contract; the earlier prototype/T01-T10 interfaces are baseline compatibility, not current gameplay rules. Do not restore approval votes, Repair/Sabotage buttons, Witness or five-node tracks. Preserve original IP and engine independence from Firebase/UI/Node. Edit only ownership; publish APIs only through explicitly owned package entrypoints, preserving baseline exports. Use original synthetic fixtures, scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. Do not commit, push, open PRs, spawn agents, provision/deploy services, access credentials or alter swarm budget. Implement provider-free lobby creation from verified temporary actor plus the approved create request. Validate name,5-10 seats,timer30/60/90/120,bot-fill/difficulty,opt-in visibility,alias/avatar and optional passcode. Allocate a canonical room code using an injected trusted code source and atomic create-if-absent with bounded collision retries. Preserve duplicate aliases and add the creator/host once. Store only salted password-hash/verifier material through the reviewed server-side hashing seam; never store/return/log the plaintext passcode or expose its hash in recipient/directory DTOs. Configuration remains a lobby operation; no seed,role or hidden outcome is accepted from clients. Use only memory/injected ports while Firebase is gated.
acceptance: Successful creation persists exact validated host configuration,creator seat and one unique room code with a public safe lobby response.
Concurrent code collisions/retries cannot overwrite a room or duplicate creator membership.
Invalid seats/timer/settings/avatar/passcode and repository/hash failures create no partial room.
Tests verify hashing/verifier isolation,duplicate aliases,visibility and omission of passcode/hash/hidden state from replies.
